name: Leave Management — Online Leave Requests
nameTh: ระบบลางานออนไลน์ — ยื่นใบลา อนุมัติ และติดตามวันลา
description: Installable Google Apps Script and Google Sheets leave request system with employee, approver and administrator roles. Includes workday and holiday validation, overlap checks, annual quota reservation, Thai PDF manual and editable landscape Remotion installation tutorial. Configure and test in the buyer's Google account before production use.
